title: All In One Features
features:
Vehicle & Movement Modifications

Spawn Car Anywhere: Allows players to summon vehicles at any location on the map, bypassing normal spawn points.

Car Speed & Fly: Modifies vehicle performance, including speed boosts and the ability to make cars fly.

Fly & NoClip: Enables the player to fly freely around the map or pass through solid objects (NoClip).

Infinite Jump: Removes the standard limit on jumps, allowing for continuous jumping.

Teleportation (TP): Provides instant travel options, such as teleporting to the center of the map, to specific players, or out of the map boundaries.

Player & Admin Controls

Admin Commands: Grants access to a panel of administrative functions, often including player moderation and management tools.

Kill Aura: Automatically eliminates other players within a certain radius without direct input.

Fling & Bring Players: Allows the user to launch other players (Fling) or forcibly teleport them to the user's location (Bring).

Invisibility & Anti-AFK: Toggles the player's visibility to others and prevents the game from kicking the player for being idle.

Visual & Aesthetic Changes

ESP (Extra Sensory Perception): Displays visual overlays that reveal the location of other players or items through walls.

Custom Effects: Enables cosmetic changes like Rainbow Effects, Neon Effects, or a "Big Head" mode.

Skybox Replacement: In more disruptive exploits, the game's sky can be replaced with custom images, as seen in incidents where the skybox was changed to a "Shrek" character.

Automation & Utility

Auto-Farm: Automates repetitive tasks, such as earning in-game currency, to save time.

Premium Item Unlocking: Allows players to obtain items that are normally locked behind a paywall or premium currency.
